_comment: Optional one-line facts for well-known cities, keyed by the city's name (whitespace-collapsed). The build composes each city's description as 'Capital of/City in <country> · pop. <X>' and appends the fact here if present. Cities without an entry just get the auto country+population line. The build reports any key here that matches no city so names can be fixed.

facts.Tokyo: The world's most populous metropolitan area.
facts.New York: Home to Wall Street, Times Square and the Statue of Liberty.
facts.Mexico City: Built on the ruins of the Aztec capital Tenochtitlán, on a drained lake bed.
facts.Mumbai: India's financial capital and home of the Bollywood film industry.
facts.São Paulo: The largest city in the Southern Hemisphere.
facts.Delhi: A sprawling metropolis layered over seven historic cities.
facts.New Delhi: India's seat of government, within the larger city of Delhi.
facts.Shanghai: China's largest city and busiest container port in the world.
facts.Kolkata: Former capital of British India, on the Hooghly River.
facts.Dhaka: Known as the rickshaw capital of the world.
facts.Buenos Aires: Birthplace of the tango, nicknamed the 'Paris of South America'.
facts.Los Angeles: Centre of the global film industry, home to Hollywood.
facts.Karachi: Pakistan's largest city and economic hub, on the Arabian Sea.
facts.Cairo: Beside the Pyramids of Giza, the largest city in the Arab world.
facts.Rio de Janeiro: Famed for Christ the Redeemer, Copacabana and Carnival.
facts.Beijing: China's capital, home to the Forbidden City and Tiananmen Square.
facts.Manila: One of the world's most densely populated cities.
facts.Moscow: Russia's capital, centred on the Kremlin and Red Square.
facts.Istanbul: The only major city straddling two continents, Europe and Asia.
facts.Paris: Home to the Eiffel Tower and the Louvre, the world's most-visited museum.
facts.Seoul: A high-tech megacity that hosted the 1988 Olympics.
facts.Lagos: Nigeria's commercial heart and one of Africa's fastest-growing cities.
facts.Jakarta: Indonesia's capital, slowly sinking — prompting a planned move to Nusantara.
facts.Chicago: Birthplace of the skyscraper, on Lake Michigan.
facts.London: Capital of the UK, on the Thames, home to Big Ben and the Tower of London.
facts.Bangkok: Thailand's capital, famous for ornate temples and street food.
facts.Tehran: Iran's capital, sitting beneath the Alborz Mountains.
facts.Bogota: A high-altitude Andean capital at about 2,640 m.
facts.Lima: Peru's capital, founded by Spanish conquistador Francisco Pizarro in 1535.
facts.Hong Kong: A dense financial hub famed for its skyline and harbour.
facts.Singapore: A wealthy island city-state and global shipping and finance hub.
facts.Sydney: Australia's largest city, known for its Opera House and Harbour Bridge.
facts.Berlin: Germany's capital, once split by the Berlin Wall.
facts.Rome: Italy's capital, the 'Eternal City', wrapped around the Colosseum and the Vatican.
facts.Madrid: Spain's capital, home of the Prado museum.
facts.Barcelona: Catalan port city famed for Gaudí's Sagrada Família.
facts.Athens: One of the world's oldest cities, birthplace of democracy.
facts.Vienna: Austria's imperial capital, a historic centre of classical music.
facts.Amsterdam: Dutch capital laced with canals and cyclists.
facts.Brussels: Belgium's capital and the de facto capital of the European Union.
facts.Lisbon: Portugal's hilly coastal capital, one of Europe's oldest cities.
facts.Dublin: Ireland's capital, on the River Liffey.
facts.Oslo: Norway's capital, at the head of the Oslofjord.
facts.København: Denmark's capital, famed for cycling and the Little Mermaid statue.
facts.Helsinki: Finland's seaside capital on the Gulf of Finland.
facts.Warsaw: Poland's capital, largely rebuilt after WWII destruction.
facts.Prague: Czech capital famed for its medieval old town and castle.
facts.Budapest: Hungary's capital, split by the Danube into Buda and Pest.
facts.Kyiv: Ukraine's capital on the Dnieper, one of Europe's oldest cities.
facts.Reykjavík: The world's northernmost capital of a sovereign state.
facts.Vatican City: Capital of the world's smallest country, seat of the Pope.
Capital of the USA, home to the White House and Capitol.
facts.San Francisco: Famous for the Golden Gate Bridge and steep hills.
facts.Toronto: Canada's largest city, beside the CN Tower and Lake Ontario.
facts.Havana: Cuba's capital, known for its vintage cars and colonial old town.
facts.Santiago: Chile's capital, framed by the snow-capped Andes.
facts.Caracas: Venezuela's capital, in a valley near the Caribbean coast.
facts.Brasília: A purpose-built capital opened in 1960, famed for modernist architecture.
facts.Cape Town: South Africa's legislative capital, beneath Table Mountain.
facts.Johannesburg: South Africa's largest city, grown from a gold-rush settlement.
facts.Nairobi: Kenya's capital, with a national park on its doorstep.
facts.Addis Ababa: Ethiopia's high-altitude capital and seat of the African Union.
facts.Casablanca: Morocco's largest city and economic hub, on the Atlantic.
facts.Dakar: Senegal's capital, on the westernmost point of mainland Africa.
facts.Kinshasa: Capital of DR Congo and one of the world's largest French-speaking cities.
facts.Riyadh: Saudi Arabia's capital, in the heart of the Arabian desert.
facts.Makkah: Islam's holiest city; destination of the annual Hajj pilgrimage.
facts.Baghdad: Iraq's capital, a medieval centre of learning on the Tigris.
facts.Jerusalem: An ancient city holy to Judaism, Christianity and Islam.
facts.Dubai: Famed for the Burj Khalifa, the world's tallest building.
facts.Abu Dhabi: Capital of the UAE, built on oil wealth.

facts.Islamabad: Pakistan's purpose-built capital, established in the 1960s.

facts.Hanoi: Vietnam's capital, over a thousand years old.
facts.Kuala Lumpur: Malaysia's capital, home to the Petronas Twin Towers.

facts.Damascus: One of the oldest continuously inhabited cities on Earth.
